applies_why: The judge text does not count any verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link; it labels the matter UNDERDETERMINED and says the issue was answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.
quote: answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: Because the judge explicitly treats the relevant material as answered, K-G4's prohibition on counting answered verses as unanswered witnesses is not violated.
